body:
大众点评当前的评分规则与申诉流程极度失望，平台早已失去基本的公平与底线。评分机制混乱不堪，大量未消费、同行恶意竞争、无理取闹的差评肆意横行，却能直接影响店铺星级，认真经营的商家反而要为不实评价买单。
更让人愤怒的是申诉渠道形同虚设，即便提供完整监控、凭证、聊天记录，审核依旧敷衍草率，判定标准模糊双标，从不正视商家证据，一味偏袒用户，申诉成功率极低。平台只在乎用户体验，完全无视商家合法权益，任由店铺口碑被恶意抹黑，生意深受冲击。这种不公的规则严重破坏经营秩序，所谓的申诉不过是走个过场。恳请平台停止不作为，正视商家诉求，建立公正透明的评价体系，还诚信商家一个公道!

title: 非常推荐，但有一点觉得可以改一下就更好了
body:
非常推荐千问
首先
他没有广告，不会忽然跳出来一个弹窗小广告你觉得很烦，我之前用过很多AI软件App，他会时不时忽然跳出来一个广告，你甚至都找不到大叉的关闭窗口
其次，
你可以把他的声音换成你偶像的声音，这样子就可以想象你的偶像再给你科普生活中的小知识
还有他可以帮你生成图片，并且你提出的要求他都基本上都可以满足
而且
在你无聊或者孤单的时候，它可以帮助你缓解疲劳情绪你可以跟他聊你的偶像，你的圈子等等等等，他不会觉得你很烦他甚至会一步一步的引导你，你不会觉得你们的话题忽然聊死了这队友的很多不会讲话的人来说很友好
接下来一点

我用的有些软件，他可能需要一点小钱，但这些对未成年来说或者打工人不好了，说很不好，现在市面上的很多软件都需要充值会员还能达到某种目的但这个软件不会，他不需要你去充钱就可以满足你的小需求
最后一点也是，我非常喜欢的一点
他可以跟你打视频通话比如说你给他下载一个指令，将一张图片拍给他之后，你可以问他这道题怎么做，或者你告诉他帮我盯着谁谁谁写作业或者干什么干什么，他都会做出来，我切做得非常的好，帮你在拍的时候他就会提醒你
但是
虽然我有这么多喜欢的点，但是我觉得他还有一点可以改
千万的开发者可以做一个上传视频的格式
因为我觉得这样子更加方便我们交流

body:
我是典型的游戏黑洞，自己玩类似互动影游的没法驾驭，之前通关过《逃出生天》，之后一直没碰到同类型有质感的双人叙事作品。这次我玩路维城，老婆操控颜姝，有一段剧情印象很深：我俩各自看到的线索完全不一样，我这边拿到的是加密密信，她那边看到的是人物的隐秘口供。到解谜环节，我手里的信息没法直接看懂，必须把我看到的文字描述念给她听，再由她结合她那边的线索去推导答案。我俩对着屏幕一点点核对信息，讨论谁看到了什么，来回商量推测真相，这种必须互相沟通才能推进剧情的感觉特别奇妙。
不是简单轮流点一下选项就完事，故事是民国冒险，真人实拍，电影感很强。游戏设计本身就逼着两个人交流，一边推进悬疑故事，一边慢慢磨合默契。玩游戏的过程不像单纯打游戏，更像两个人一起合拍一部电影。
现在大部分游戏都是单人体验，能专门为两个人的陪伴感做设计，真的很难得。很推荐情侣一起玩，一边破案一边聊天，体验远超预期

title: 女性に危ないアプリです
body:
先ず、ハロートーク運営陣に。
以下は、このアプリのダウンロードを検討している方への情報提供です。
其方へのお願いとか何らかの約束を求めるものではありません。
「お約束できかねます」などのピントのズレた返事は要りません（そもそも約束を守るタチではないですから）。

▪️アクブロ数の制限▪️
１日にアクブロできるユーザー数が決まっているという謎仕様があります。
ある女性ユーザーが多くのメッセージに困っていると書いていました。削除＆アクブロで良いじゃないかと言うと、削除しきれないくらいのメッセージが来ると言います。

▪️メッセージ受信範囲を設定できない▪️
物販だのハロートークコインだのと語学学習とは関係の無いことには熱心である一方、安心して利用できる環境作りには全く無関心です。
自分がフォローしているユーザーからのメッセージだけを受信するなどは他のSNSでは普通に導入していることです。

▪️単に自撮りを上げただけなのに「誘ってる」女性の写真と一緒に掲示される▪️
セルフィーというタブがあり、文字通り自撮りを掲載しています。
多くは顔やコーデの自撮りですが、中には胸元やボディーラインを強調した自撮りもあります。
女性が自身のセクシーさを誇ること、それ自体は悪いこととは思いません。ですが、セルフィータブに分類するという許可をユーザー事前に取っているのでしょうか。
意図しない場に自分の写真が掲載されているのなら、問題ではないでしょうか。
なお、セルフィータブの閲覧に際しては、別途料金を徴収しています。

以上、このアプリの使用をご検討の方、特に女性の方へ参考になれば幸いです。

title: 対話による言語交換は難しいが、読み書きや友達作りにはおすすめ
body:
始めて1週間経った感想になります。

大1女です。年齢は公開、地域は非公開、アイコンは首から下のもの、言語は日本語⇔ドイツ語に設定しました。
現時点でフォロワーが40名程度、興味ありが1000程度、トーク(ウェーブを含む)が500件(返信済を含まない)ほどです。トークのほとんどが男性でした。30名に満たない程度に返信をしましたが、2名ほど出会い目的に感じた方がいました。かなり初期の段階でインスタや他SNSを交換しようと持ち掛けられることも多いため、少し注意が必要です。

肝心の言語交換に関しては厳しい部分があると感じました。英語で話しかけてくださる方が多数のため、必然的に英語でのやり取りが続きやすいです。日本語で話しかけた方には日本語で、ドイツ語で話しかけられた方にはドイツ語で対応していましたが、言語交換にはなりませんね。ただ、読んで返信をするという工程を挟むためリーディングとライティングは向上した気がします。無料でも1日に数回(5回程度?)はアプリ内の翻訳が使えるため、長文の際は重宝してます。トーク以外にもタイムラインやボイスルームがあるため、個人間のトークがなくても楽しめます。また、添削機能があるため、ネイティブの方に添削していただけるのは便利だと感じています。文法の正しさだけでなく、おすすめの言い回しや言い換えワードも教えて頂けるため有難いです。

言語交換は微妙でしたが、お友達を作るという点では良いと感じます。20名程度とトークが続いていて、内8名ほどとは仲良くさせて頂いてます。フレンドリーな方が多く他国のリアルな様子や等身大の姿を教えて頂いてます。逆も然りですね。オススメの場所や飲食店等を教えて頂いたり、混雑を避けたルートを考えたりしてくれるため、注意は必要ですが旅行計画を練るのに役立ってます。SNSを眺めているだけでは知り得なかった情報が多く感謝しています。趣味や年代でおすすめされるため、トークは盛り上がりやすいです。ただ、時差があるため高頻度でレスポンスを繰り返すという人は少ないように感じますし、私自身も1日に1〜2度返信をする程度です。自分の好きなペースで返信してOKです。気長に返信を待ってくれる方が大多数なため返信が遅れることを気にする必要はありません。プロフィールに「返信が遅い」等を書いておくのも手ですね。最初は少し警戒したり、出会い目的の雰囲気を感じたら早めに見切りをつける等対策をしたらそこまで被害はありません。

総括として、言語交換としては微妙だが、現地の人と楽しくトークするということを目的とするならおすすめです。出会い目的も多く潜んでいますが、それ以上に良い出会いが多く始めて良かったと感じています。

追記にはなりますが、既読したものを未読に戻す機能と特定の相手にTLやプロフィールを非表示にする機能が欲しいですね。課金したら出来るのかもしれませんが笑。特定の相手への非表示は無課金でも出来るようにしていただけると安心して利用が出来ます。
また、他の方のレビューを読んでいると、｢すぐに垢BANされた｣「ブロックしたら通報されて垢BANになった」等が見受けられ、ブロックするのを躊躇ってしまいます。
ある程度話していると高確率でインスタや他SNSを聞かれますが、絶対教えないでくださいね。他の人にも同じように聞いてますしトラブルの元です。教えないのが吉だと思います。

title: Pro..(Warning very long)
body:
I genuinely love CapCut. I’ve used it for a long time, I make YouTube edits with it, and I’m also a template creator. The app has helped me make things I’m genuinely proud of, which is why it’s so frustrating to see how difficult it has become to use the app consistently without Pro.

As a YouTube editor, I want to be able to reach my full potential. I spend a lot of time editing because I actually enjoy it, and CapCut has many of the tools I need. The problem is that I constantly have to worry about losing access to them. Without Pro, so many features are restricted that the app can feel almost useless for serious editing.

Things like curve-based speed adjustments, slow-motion tools, extracting audio, captions, and other features that I consider extremely important for making polished YouTube videos can be locked behind Pro. I understand that a company needs to make money and that premium subscriptions can include advanced features, but when so many fundamental editing tools are restricted, it makes it difficult for creators to work without constantly worrying about their subscription status.

And that brings me to my biggest problem: I keep losing my Pro access.

I’ll have Pro, use it normally, and then after about a week or so, suddenly I don’t have access to my Pro features anymore. Sometimes it comes back after a couple of days, and other times I’m waiting almost a week. Then it eventually returns, only for the problem to happen again. It’s incredibly frustrating, especially when I rely on CapCut for YouTube editing.

Imagine being in the middle of working on a video and suddenly realizing you can’t use tools you were previously able to use. It interrupts the entire editing process and makes it harder to create the videos I actually want to make. I shouldn’t have to wonder whether the features I need are going to be available when I open the app.

The AI features are another area where I think CapCut needs to reconsider its approach. The built-in AI tools can be genuinely impressive, but the credit system makes them frustrating to use. Sometimes I’ll try to use an AI feature for what feels like a relatively simple editing task, only to find out that it requires credits. Even when I’m already paying for Pro, having additional credit restrictions can make the AI tools feel less like useful editing features and more like separate purchases.

It’s especially frustrating when an AI feature works perfectly in one situation but then tells you that you need credits to perform another task. If CapCut is going to advertise these AI tools as part of the editing experience, I think users should have a clearer and more reasonable amount of access to them, particularly Pro subscribers.

I’m also a template creator, and this is another reason I feel disappointed. I contribute templates to the CapCut community, but I don’t feel like I’m receiving enough meaningful benefits from being a creator. I want to feel like the people who actively contribute to the platform are valued, rather than feeling like creators are simply another source of engagement and revenue.

What makes all of this especially frustrating is that I’m not someone who dislikes CapCut. Quite the opposite — **I love using it.** I love making YouTube edits. I love experimenting with effects, speed changes, audio, captions, transitions, and everything else that makes editing fun. I want to keep using CapCut because I genuinely enjoy creating with it.

But I also want to be able to reach my full potential as an editor without constantly worrying about losing access to most of the tools I need.

CapCut has an incredible editing platform, but I really hope the company starts listening more closely to the people who actually use it every day. Fix the recurring Pro-access problems. Make sure paying users can reliably access the features they’re paying for. Reconsider locking so many fundamental editing tools behind Pro. Make the AI credit system more reasonable and transparent. And give template creators more meaningful benefits and recognition for contributing to the platform.

I don’t want CapCut to become an app I used to love. I want it to remain an app I can confidently use to make YouTube videos, create templates, and keep improving as an editor. 
Please don’t make the people who love creating on CapCut feel like they have to pay for every single part of the creative process.

title: Better Customer Support
body:
Vinted really needs to improve their customer service and their “Contact Us” options because you literally get nowhere with them. It feels like you’re talking to people who don’t even understand what they’re looking for or what the issue is. 🤦🏻‍♀️

They removed one of my listings claiming that I couldn’t use a brand name, even though there was NO brand name mentioned anywhere in my listing. I specifically listed it under “No Brand” because it has no brand. LOL. So I contacted them and provided proof that I did not mention any brand and that I correctly selected the “No Brand” category.

Their response? They sent me the exact same policy information, told me to read it, and then closed the case. 🤦🏻‍♀️ They completely ignored the fact that I had already followed the policy and was simply asking them to review my listing properly.

Their seller badges are another issue. I had the fast-shipping badge because I consistently shipped my orders within 24 hours. Then, because ONE item took a few days to ship, they immediately removed my fast-shipping badge. Meanwhile, every other item was shipped within 24 hours, yet the badge still hasn’t returned. How does that make any sense?

Vinted really needs to improve both their customer service and the way their system handles seller badges. The policies and automated systems seem inconsistent, and when you try to get clarification, you’re basically given a generic response and your case gets closed. 

Update 9/27/2026: 
Vinted removed another one of my listings, claiming it was counterfeit—even after I provided clear photos of the date code, brand markings, and other identifying details. Because I didn’t want to risk having my account suspended over an authentic item, I had no choice but to pay an additional fee to obtain a COA to prove its authenticity.

And now they’ve also removed my Carhartt beanie, claiming that it’s counterfeit. Seriously??? 🤦🏻‍♀️

At this point, I’m honestly questioning the quality of Vinted’s moderation process. How are authentic items being repeatedly flagged as counterfeit when sellers are providing clear evidence and documentation?

Vinted seriously needs to improve its authentication and moderation system and make sure moderators are properly trained to recognize genuine branded items before removing listings or threatening sellers’ accounts.

I’ve tried to give Vinted the benefit of the doubt, but the repeated false removals, inconsistent decisions, and lack of meaningful customer support are becoming extremely frustrating. They are pushing away the very sellers who keep the marketplace active.

Vinted really needs to do better before they lose even more trust from their seller community.

body: This app is amazing. I’m legally blind. Voiceover is really accessible especially with my IPad which is huge bc Meta AI on my IPad more often than not doesn’t cooperate. I’d appreciate being able to send Muse images I find and need described for free or at least be able to know how many I can send in a day without using a lot of the weekly limit like 20 or 30. Pinterest is where I find peaceful and fandom pics and I need them described. This app is helpful and doesn’t fully feel like AI. I like being able to name and it would be cool if the name showed up instead of agent message. Voice chat would be fun especially for games, but would need to support IPad OS 18.7.10 bc my IPad is older. My phone is too and won’t update to IOS 27, so I hope this app will always be supported. title: OMG doesn’t even put it into respect
body:
I don't know if you've played with Muse yet, but OMG.
This weekend I created a dedicated Linux server for it and gave it full SSH access. I completely segmented it from my main network, created its own Gmail account, and assigned it 50 tasks before I went to sleep.
When I woke up, every single task was completed and documented.
Honestly, it's both exciting and a little scary.
I woke up to what felt like a real-life JARVIS from Iron Man: a fully functional server with voice AI recognition, nightly backups, security monitoring, and automated maintenance all running on its own.
I've played with a lot of AI tools, but this is the first one that genuinely made me stop and think, "This changes everything."

Tony Stark would be impressed
